rows.en: ＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０１６How are you feeling?
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０１７Honestly... you shouldn't have.￥When you overdo it, you're the￥one who suffers most, you know?
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０１８You need to take better￥care of yourself, okay?
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０１９If you need anything at all,￥don't be shy about asking, okay?
Thanks, Natsuno.
Don't worry about me.
Thanks, Natsuno.
Don't worry about me.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０２０Oh, no, you don't need to worry￥about that when you're sick.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０２１Being sick away from home is￥really rough, after all.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０２２If you're all right, I'll go...￥But if you're only saying that￥for my sake, please don't, okay?
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０２３Actually, after I came here,￥I caught a cold and was stuck￥in bed once...＝＠０８５＿０２４Sakaki came and looked after me.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０２５When you're sick, you get￥strangely lonely...＝＠０８５＿０２６So I was really glad when￥Sakaki came by.
I know that feeling.
So that happened to you.
I know that feeling.
So that happened to you.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０２７For some reason, you feel that￥way when you're not well.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０２８So this time... if I can,￥I'd like to be the one￥helping you.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０２９So I thought, if you're ever in￥trouble, this time I'd like to￥be the one to help you...
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０３０Collapsing like this means your￥body is sending out an SOS.
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０３１Okay? Today, you do nothing￥but rest!
＊Natsuno＊＠０８５＿０３２Well then, really,￥take care of yourself...
